name: HubSpot Dead-Lead Recycling & Nurture Re-Entry Router (Safe-by-Default)

parameters.content:
## HubSpot Dead-Lead Recycling & Nurture Re-Entry Router

**Safe by default.** With no env vars this runs in **SANDBOX_MODE** on a synthetic fixture: zero network calls, nothing stamped, enrolled or listed. See **Dry-Run Routing Report**.

Population: contacts on closed-lost deals + disqualified lead statuses. Eligible after **COOLING_OFF_DAYS (120)** since the latest touch; hard suppressions first (unsubscribed, bounced, open deal, excluded lost reasons, customers, recycle cap). Cooled-off contacts are re-verified (email + job title) and routed to an outbound **sequence** or **nurture**.

Opt-ins: `SANDBOX_MODE=false` → `DRY_RUN=false` + `HUBSPOT_WRITES_ENABLED=true` (stamps) → `SEQUENCE_ENROLLMENT_ENABLED=true` / `NURTURE_ROUTING_ENABLED=true`. Enrichment needs `ENRICHMENT_ENABLED=true`. Tokens only via `$env`. See README.md.

nodes.name: Daily Recycle Run (06:41)
nodes.notes: Daily at 06:41 in the instance time zone. Ships inactive.

nodes.name: Config & Safety Gate
nodes.notes: Env-only config, cooling-off window, qualification rules, enrichment adapter, routing targets, caps, write gates.

nodes.name: Load Synthetic Recycle Fixture
nodes.notes: SANDBOX only: fictitious deals / contacts with dates relative to now.

nodes.name: HubSpot: Search Closed-Lost Deals
nodes.notes: Read-only: closed-lost stages with close date between lookback start and the cooling-off cutoff.

nodes.name: Collect Deals & Build Association Reads
nodes.notes: Fail closed at 10,000 results or truncated pagination.

nodes.name: HubSpot: Search Disqualified Contacts
nodes.notes: Read-only: contacts whose hs_lead_status is in DISQUALIFIED_LEAD_STATUSES.

nodes.name: HubSpot: Read Contacts & Deal Links
nodes.notes: Batch read contact properties + contact -> deal links (read-only).

nodes.name: HubSpot: Batch Read Associated Deals
nodes.notes: Open-deal check: hs_is_closed for every associated deal (read-only).

nodes.name: Evaluate Cooling-Off & Suppression
nodes.notes: Latest-touch cooling-off clock, hard suppressions, enrichment budget.

nodes.name: Enrichment API: Verify Contact
nodes.notes: Provider-agnostic email + job-title re-verification. Key from $env only. Failures -> HOLD (retried next run).

nodes.name: Route Re-Entry
nodes.notes: OUTBOUND / NURTURE / SUPPRESS / HOLD, caps, routing report.

nodes.name: HubSpot: Check Active Enrollment
nodes.notes: Read-only: skip contacts already enrolled in a sequence.

nodes.name: HubSpot: Enroll in Sequence
nodes.notes: Sequence enrollment. NO automatic retry (an enrollment sends email); failures -> HOLD, retried next run after the active-enrollment check.

nodes.name: Build Contact Updates
nodes.notes: Final statuses + recycle_* stamps (only changed records) + nurture list adds.

nodes.name: HubSpot: Update Contacts & Nurture List
nodes.notes: Contact batch update (recycle_* stamps) and static-list membership add. Idempotent: retries are safe.
